methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: The study focuses on the practice and experience of experts in measuring the energy performance of domestic buildings in the UK.

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Exclusive focus on domestic (residential) building energy performance measurement with no industrial component; a qualitative interview study of nine UK practitioners' practice that does not present, propose, evaluate, or characterise any EnPI/EnB measurement model (RdSAP named only incidentally).
